overlays.summary: Grok-Bot-style remote desktop tab for the Bot drawer, over the product client's __dshDesktop bridge; delegates to the bridge's renderPane when the product client registered one.

Adds the 电脑操作 (desktop) tab to a 1:1 Bot's drawer and renders DesktopPane in it; a thread Session keeps its own transcript, stats, questions and usage, and its name is shown instead of offering to rename the Bot.
Renders the product's sidebarAddon under the team list and preserves an intentionally selected thread Session instead of redirecting it to the Bot's default chat.
Opens each thread's own Session, keeps homeToMainBot from redirecting known threads, refreshes thread projections and supplies bounded header navigation with native roster and Session readiness.
Supports Harness 0.2.2 section-only prompt assembly while retaining the independent hidden-tool execution guard.
Adapts legacy per-Session schedules to the explicit Host-wide Schedule API in Harness 0.2.2 without changing task targets.

Renders the product conversationAddon after the native header identity, preserving goals, activity and slot component identity, and names the open thread beside its Bot so two contexts of one Bot are never confused.
Adds trusted thread records and archives their Sessions on Bot delete; automatic greetings wait for committed model, capability, funding and runtime readiness.

Indexes a Bot thread Session as another own chat of the same Bot: live threads sit in chatOwners/threadOwners, archived ones in pastOwners with no authority, and threadsOf/threadOf/threadSessionOf/sessionsOfBot are exposed for the product.
Keeps the part steward off thread Sessions: a thread is not a part chain, so nothing condenses it or hands its input on to the Bot default chat.
Applies a Bot model change to its live thread Sessions as it already does for group Sessions.
Attributes a thread Session usage to its Bot through the shared sessionsOfBot list.
Covers thread Sessions when a private Bot files are purged.
Renews memory for thread Sessions when a Bot memory is archived.
Projects Bot threads and pending initial setup to the client; archived thread input is refused instead of redirected to default chat.

Indexes thread Sessions in a read-only threadsById map by Session id and thread id, resolves a thread Session to its Bot in byId (never taking a Bot's own chat identity), and exports isOwnChatOf so Bot-scoped surfaces recognise a thread as another own chat of the same Bot.
The Bot's model-choice dock belongs to a thread too: it recognises a thread Session as another own chat of the same Bot instead of only the default chat.
Memory learning proposals are shown for a thread Session, which is another own chat of the same Bot, not only for the default chat.
The secret-request dock waits for a thread Session's own cards, so a tool asking for a secret inside a thread is answered there.
Thread repair actions and historical failure attribution use the failed request or active Host block; a new model selection cannot relabel old authentication failures.
The AI settings page renders the plugin-owned provider manager without modifying Harness provider settings.
The product-owned React settings bridge exposes no credentials or model authority.
